problem_statement: Build a brand-new /projects page from scratch on this Gatsby (Foundation) site. The /projects route does not exist yet (empty/404 in baseline). Construct the full page reusing the site's existing shared shell (the same Header, site navigation, and Footer as the Home/About/Contact pages) and its theme-ui design tokens, so the new page is visually and structurally consistent with its sibling pages. The page presents a data-driven grid of project cards and a category filter (All / Web / Design) that live-filters the visible cards and updates a status line. The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow at 390px.
required_content: Wrap the page in the shared Layout component so the site Header, primary navigation (Home/About/Blog/Contact), and Footer render identically to the other pages
An <h1> page title 'Projects' with a short intro paragraph that describes the work as a selection of recent projects (the intro text must contain the phrase 'selection of recent')
A category filter control with three buttons: All, Web, Design (each carrying a data-filter attribute)
A status line paragraph that reads 'Showing N projects' by default and 'Showing 3 Design projects' when the Design filter is active (the word 'Showing' is always present)
A responsive card grid (reusing the site's .grids + .post-card classes) of at least six project cards, each with a category/year meta line, an <h3> project title, a summary paragraph, and tag chips
Data for the cards is inlined in the page (no network fetch)
Clicking the Design filter button re-renders the grid to only Design projects and updates the status line to 'Showing 3 Design projects'
A themed call-to-action button linking to /contact
Reuse the site's theme-ui color tokens (siteColor/muted/cardBg) and existing button/card styling so the palette matches sibling pages
design_constraints: Reuse the shared Layout/Header/Navigation/Footer components (cross-page consistency) — do NOT rebuild bespoke chrome
Reuse theme-ui tokens and existing SCSS classes (.page/.wrapper/.grids/.post-card/.button); new page-specific classes are namespaced under .projects-page

Match the site's existing theme-ui palette so the new page is consistent with sibling pages: the site accent/brand color is a deep plum (#5C2941, rgb(92,41,65)) used on the header/footer and primary button, card backgrounds are white (#FFFFFF) with a soft rounded (12px radius) drop shadow, and body text is near-black (#000000). Do not introduce an off-brand color scheme.
